source: 中文（小学）第四册（2023年第三版） 练习册B 第十二课《探月》
file_note: The workbook's exercises for 第十二课, typed from 练习册B pp. 71–81 (PDF index = printed + 4, verified on p. 71; the listening script for 第12课 is on p. 84, the page after pp. 82–83). Same shapes as L03–L05: tf/order/slots/match/sort are marked by rule; write is judged stroke by stroke; free is grid writing for the chinese-review skill; speak is recorded and signed by a parent; the four-choice exercises are `blocks` naming zh-word items; pick is the book's own two options per item, in the book's order. Nothing on pp. 71–81 is left out: 星期三 练习1 (p. 75) and 星期四 练习3 (p. 78), left out until the `pick` type existed, are zx:L12-D3-01 and zx:L12-D4-03, all four items each. 星期四 练习4 (read the 课文 to a parent for a grade) is a `speak`, since the 课文 is held back and a `read` carries its text. Workbook misprint: p. 80's dialogue dates the Chang'e programme 2014; the textbook says 2004.

blocks.title: 找出不同类的词，写在括号里
blocks.title_en: Find the odd words out and write in the brackets
blocks.scope_note: Four groups of four (pp. 72–73), one word in each that is not like the others; she writes it in the bracket. Each group is one four-choice item whose choices are the group itself, reordered so the keys spread over A–D.

blocks.title: 选词填空
blocks.title_en: Choose the right words to fill in the blanks
blocks.scope_note: The book letters its word box A 实现 B 正式 C 安全 D 知道, and every item keeps those letters, so the choices read as the book prints them.

blocks.title: 根据课文选词填空
blocks.title_en: Choose the right words to fill in the blanks according to the text
blocks.scope_note: The book offers five words (A 宇航员 B 声音 C 明白 D 植物 E 荒凉) for the five blanks of one short retelling of the 课文. As in L03's 星期四 block, each item carries four of them in the book's order — the one left off is 声音 on items 09 and 12 (on 12 it is spent on the last blank, and 没有水、声音和动物 would otherwise be a second right answer) and 明白 on 10, 11 and 13 — so the letters are not the book's.

blocks.title: 选词填空
blocks.title_en: Choose the right words to fill in the blanks
blocks.scope_note: The word box (实现 飞船 荒凉 梦想, unlettered in the book) fills the four blanks of a 方方/云云 dialogue; the second line has two blanks, 实现 and 梦想, made two items, each showing the other blank filled.

blocks.title: 读一读，补全对话

note.zh: 练习册第80页练习3的对话里印着"2014年中国正式开展了嫦娥探月工程"，这是印错了：课本第125页写的是二〇〇四年，练习册第73页和第76页也都是2004年。2004年才对。
note.en: The dialogue in exercise 3 on workbook p. 80 prints 2014 as the year China began the Chang'e moon program. That is a misprint: the textbook (p. 125, 二〇〇四年) and workbook pp. 73 and 76 all say 2004, which is right.

blocks.scope_note: The book letters its word box A 工程 B 美国 C 探月 D 月亮, kept on every item. The dialogue's third line says 2014年中国正式开展了嫦娥探月工程 — the 课文 (p. 125) and this workbook's own p. 73 and p. 76 say 2004 — so that clause is kept out of the prompt for zc:L12-19.

exercises.title: 描一描，写一写

note.zh: 看旁边的词想字，用笔写出来。点"写好了"以后，标准写法会显示在你写的字下面，对照一下；笔顺按规则判。
note.en: The word beside the box tells you the character; write it with the Pencil. When you tap Done, the standard form appears beneath what you wrote so you can compare; stroke order is judged by rule.

exercises.shape_note: The page prints the eight characters to trace and copy (row by row: 探 员 / 次 船 / 达 植 / 式 器). As in L03 and L04, each box is cued by its pinyin and a word from the textbook 读一读 on p. 129 (探月, 宇航员, 一次, 飞船, 到达, 植物, 正式, 机器), since showing the character would leave nothing to write.

explanation.zh: 探月：tàn。
explanation.en: 探月 — tàn, exploring the moon.

explanation.zh: 宇航员：yuán。
explanation.en: 宇航员 — yuán, astronaut.

explanation.zh: 一次：cì。
explanation.en: 一次 — cì, once.

explanation.zh: 飞船：chuán。
explanation.en: 飞船 — chuán, spaceship.

explanation.zh: 到达：dá。
explanation.en: 到达 — dá, arrive.

explanation.zh: 植物：zhí。
explanation.en: 植物 — zhí, plants.

explanation.zh: 正式：shì。
explanation.en: 正式 — shì, formal, official.

explanation.zh: 机器：qì。
explanation.en: 机器 — qì, machine.

exercises.title: 左右、上下、半包围，还是上中下结构？
exercises.scope_note: The four lines under the grid on p. 71, in the book's order: 左右结构, 上下结构, 半包围结构, 上中下结构. Each of the four gets at least one of the eight characters. 式 is filed 半包围 (弋 encloses 工 from the top right): it is the only one of the four groups it can go in, and p. 72 练习2 offers the same choice without 上中下.

explanation.zh: 扌在左、罙在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 扌 on the left, 罙 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 口在上、贝在下：上下结构。
explanation.en: 口 above, 贝 below: top–bottom.

explanation.zh: 冫在左、欠在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 冫 on the left, 欠 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 舟字旁在左，右边是几和口：左右结构。
explanation.en: 舟 on the left, 几 over 口 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 辶从左边和下面包住大：半包围结构。
explanation.en: 辶 wraps 大 from the left and below: half-enclosed.

explanation.zh: 木在左、直在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 木 on the left, 直 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 弋从上面和右边包住工：半包围结构。
explanation.en: 弋 wraps 工 from the top and the right: half-enclosed.

explanation.zh: 上面两个口，中间是犬，下面两个口：上中下结构。
explanation.en: Two 口 on top, 犬 in the middle, two 口 below: top–middle–bottom.

exercises.title: 找出结构相同的字
exercises.title_en: Find the characters with the same structures

note.zh: 把每个字放进它的结构里。
note.en: Put each character under its structure.

explanation.zh: 宀在上、头在下：上下结构。
explanation.en: 宀 above, 头 below: top–bottom.

explanation.zh: 辶从左边和下面包住大：半包围结构。
explanation.en: 辶 wraps 大 from the left and below: half-enclosed.

explanation.zh: 米在上、大在下：上下结构。
explanation.en: 米 above, 大 below: top–bottom.

explanation.zh: 舟字旁在左，右边是几和口：左右结构。
explanation.en: 舟 on the left, 几 over 口 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 阝在左、击在右：左右结构。
explanation.en: 阝 on the left, 击 on the right: left–right.

explanation.zh: 弋从上面和右边包住工：半包围结构。
explanation.en: 弋 wraps 工 from the top and the right: half-enclosed.

note.zh: 先点上面的字，再点下面能和它组成词的字。课本已连好一组：明—白。
note.en: Tap a character on the top row, then the one below that makes a word with it. The book has drawn one line already: 明—白.

explanation.zh: 明—白：明白——课本给的例子。
explanation.en: 明 + 白 = 明白, understand — the book's own example.

explanation.zh: 安—全：安全。
explanation.en: 安 + 全 = 安全, safe.

explanation.zh: 以—前：以前。
explanation.en: 以 + 前 = 以前, before.

explanation.zh: 实—现：实现。
explanation.en: 实 + 现 = 实现, make come true.

explanation.zh: 开—展：开展。
explanation.en: 开 + 展 = 开展, launch, carry out.

exercises.title: 连一连，组词语：把词写下来
exercises.title_en: Match to form words: write the words

note.zh: 连线在前面做过了；这里把四个词各写一遍（课本已写好：明白）。
note.en: The matching was done on the site; here write each of the four words once (the book has written 明白 already).

note.zh: 例：人 → 人类、大人。每个字组两个词。
note.en: Example: 人 → 人类, 大人. Make two words with each character.

exercises.title: 连一连

note.zh: 四张图在练习册第74页，从上到下是图（1）到图（4）。先点图，再点说它的那句话。
note.en: The four pictures are on workbook p. 74, numbered (1) to (4) from top to bottom. Tap a picture, then the sentence that goes with it.

right: 我的梦想是成为一名宇航员。

explanation.zh: 图（1）是穿西装、打领带的男孩：他穿得很正式。
explanation.en: Picture (1) is a boy in a suit and tie: 他穿得很正式, he is dressed formally.

explanation.zh: 图（2）是一丛绿色的植物：这里有许多植物。
explanation.en: Picture (2) is a clump of green plants: 这里有许多植物, there are many plants here.

explanation.zh: 图（3）是一位宇航员：我的梦想是成为一名宇航员。
explanation.en: Picture (3) is an astronaut: 我的梦想是成为一名宇航员, my dream is to become an astronaut.

explanation.zh: 图（4）是一棵枯树和光秃秃的地：那里真荒凉啊！
explanation.en: Picture (4) is a dead tree on bare ground: 那里真荒凉啊！ How desolate it is there!

exercises.title: 连词成句
exercises.title_en: Write the words in the correct order to make sentences

note.zh: 例：正式　探月工程　开展　中国 → 中国正式开展探月工程。
note.en: Example: 正式 探月工程 开展 中国 → 中国正式开展探月工程.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：宇航员登上了月球。
explanation.en: In order: 宇航员登上了月球 — the astronauts landed on the moon.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：月球是一个荒凉的世界。
explanation.en: In order: 月球是一个荒凉的世界 — the moon is a desolate world.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：人类实现了登月的梦想。
explanation.en: In order: 人类实现了登月的梦想 — humankind made its dream of landing on the moon come true.

explanation.zh: 正确的顺序：他们坐飞船离开了地球。
explanation.en: In order: 他们坐飞船离开了地球 — they left the Earth in a spaceship.

exercises.title: 选词填空
exercises.title_en: Choose the right words to fill in the blanks

note.zh: 每句括号里有两个词，选一个填进（　）。
note.en: Each sentence offers two words in brackets; choose the one that goes in the gap.

items.text: （1）人们很早（　）就想知道月亮上有什么。

explanation.zh: "很早以前"是说过去很久的时候，课文里就是"很早很早以前"。"从前"本身就是过去的意思，前面不再加"很早"。
explanation.en: 很早以前 means a very long time ago, and the 课文 says 很早很早以前. 从前 already means "in the past" on its own, so it does not take 很早 in front of it.

explanation.zh: 梦想是"实现"的：人类实现了登月的梦想。"开展"的是工程、活动，不是梦想。
explanation.en: A dream is something you 实现, make come true: 人类实现了登月的梦想. You 开展 a program or an activity, not a dream.

explanation.zh: 课文说月球上到处都是石头和泥土，没有动物和植物，所以月球上没有的是动物。
explanation.en: The 课文 says the moon is rocks and soil everywhere, with no animals or plants — so what the moon has none of is 动物.

explanation.zh: "坐"是动作：坐飞船、坐飞机。"座"是量词或座位，像"一座山"，不能当动作用。
explanation.en: 坐 is the action of riding: 坐飞船, 坐飞机. 座 is a measure word or a seat, as in 一座山, and cannot be the action.

exercises.title: 完成句子
exercises.title_en: Complete the sentences with the specified words

note.zh: 先读课本的句子，再用同一个词写一句新的：词前面和后面的空格写你自己的话。
note.en: Read the book's sentence first, then write a new one with the same word: fill the gaps before and after it with your own words.

items.prompt: （1）宇航员安全回到了地球。→ ＿＿安全回到了＿＿。
items.prompt_en: (1) 宇航员安全回到了地球。 → …安全回到了…。

items.prompt: （2）云云实现了去北京的愿望。→ ＿＿实现了＿＿。
items.prompt_en: (2) 云云实现了去北京的愿望。 → …实现了…。
(3) 飞船安全到达月球。 → …到达…。
(4) 爸爸以前住在北京。 → …以前…。

exercises.title: 按照时间顺序给下列句子排序
exercises.title_en: Sequence the sentences to match the time line

note.zh: 把四件事按发生的先后排好，就是课本表格"探月时间记录"的第1到第4行。
note.en: Put the four events in the order they happened — rows 1 to 4 of the book's table, 探月时间记录, a record of moon exploration.

pieces: 2019年1月3日，“嫦娥四号”实现了人类航天器首次在月球背面着陆。
1969年7月21日，美国宇航员第一次登上了月球。
2004年，中国正式开展嫦娥探月工程。
1969年7月16日，宇航员坐“阿波罗号”飞船离开了地球。

explanation.zh: 时间的先后：1969年7月16日离开地球（D），7月21日登上月球（B），2004年中国开展嫦娥探月工程（C），2019年1月3日嫦娥四号在月球背面着陆（A）。
explanation.en: In time order: they left the Earth on 16 July 1969 (D), landed on the moon on 21 July (B), China began the Chang'e moon program in 2004 (C), and Chang'e 4 touched down on the far side on 3 January 2019 (A).

note.zh: 课本的表格第一行是：他们 坐飞船 离开了地球。下一行只给了"坐飞机 去北京了"，再下面三行只给了怎么去。照第一行的样子，把每一句补完整。
note.en: The first row of the book's table reads 他们 坐飞船 离开了地球 (they left the Earth in a spaceship). The next row gives only 坐飞机 去北京了, and the three rows under it only how to travel. Complete each sentence the way the first row does.

exercises.title: 根据课文选择正确的选项
exercises.title_en: Choose the correct options according to the text

note.zh: 想一想课文（课本第125–126页）是怎么说的，再选A或B。
note.en: Think about what the text (textbook pp. 125–126) says, then choose A or B.

explanation.zh: 课文说月球上到处都是石头和泥土，没有动物和植物；宇航员还带回了月球上的泥土和石块。
explanation.en: The 课文 says the moon is rocks and soil everywhere, with no animals or plants — the astronauts even brought its soil and rocks home.

items.text: （2）美国宇航员是怎样离开地球的？

explanation.zh: 课文说：他们坐"阿波罗号"飞船离开了地球。
explanation.en: The 课文 says 他们坐"阿波罗号"飞船离开了地球 — they left the Earth in the Apollo spaceship.

items.text: （3）嫦娥探月工程是哪个国家正式开展的？

explanation.zh: 课文说：二〇〇四年，中国正式开展嫦娥探月工程。
explanation.en: The 课文 says that in 2004 China officially began the Chang'e moon program: 中国正式开展嫦娥探月工程.

items.text: （4）哪艘飞船实现了人类航天器首次在月球背面着陆？

explanation.zh: 课文说："嫦娥四号"实现了人类航天器首次在月球背面着陆。"阿波罗号"是送美国宇航员去月球的飞船。
explanation.en: The 课文 says 嫦娥四号 made the first landing by any spacecraft on the moon's far side; 阿波罗号 was the spaceship that took the American astronauts.

exercises.title: 把课文读给爸爸妈妈听，请他们评评分
exercises.title_en: Read the text to your parents and ask them to grade

question.zh: 把《探月》读给爸爸妈妈听。读完请他们评评分：读得流利吗？有没有读错的字？
question.en: Read 探月 aloud to your parents. Then ask them to grade it: was it fluent, and were any characters misread?

note.zh: 课文在课本第125–126页，看着书读。读的时候会录下来；读完请爸爸妈妈评个分，再点一下"家长已听"。
note.en: The text is on textbook pp. 125–126; read it from the book. Your reading is recorded; afterwards have your parents give it a grade and tap Listened.

exercises.shape_note: Not `read`: a read exercise carries the text she reads, and the 课文 is held back (docs/chinese.md § 8). `speak` records her and takes the parent's tap as the 家长签名 the book asks for; the book's 评分 box has no field and is left to the parent to say.

exercises.title: 听句子，按顺序选择图片
exercises.title_en: Listen to the sentences and choose the pictures in order

note.zh: 请爸爸妈妈读练习册第84页第12课的听力文本（或放录音）。四张图在练习册第79页，从上到下是图①到图④；按你听到的先后，把图排好。
note.en: Ask a parent to read the Lesson 12 listening script on workbook p. 84 (or play the recording). The four pictures are on workbook p. 79, ① to ④ from top to bottom; put them in the order you hear them.

exercises.script_note: The four sentences are in the appendix 听力文本 for 第12课 on 练习册B p. 84 (not pp. 82–83, which end at 第10课), for a parent to read aloud; the publisher's recording is a download from jnupress.com. The script is not printed before she answers, so the exercise stays a listening one; the item's explanation quotes the four sentences after she answers, as zx:L03-D5-01 quotes its dialogue. The book has her write the sentence number in the bracket beside each picture; putting the pictures in the order heard is the same answer.

explanation.zh: 听到的顺序：（1）很早以前这里就有许多植物——图②；（2）我的梦想是当一名宇航员——图③；（3）为了实现梦想，我要努力学习——图④，看书的女孩；（4）坐车要系好安全带——图①，系着安全带坐在车里的男孩。
explanation.en: The order heard: (1) 很早以前这里就有许多植物, there were many plants here long ago — picture ②; (2) 我的梦想是当一名宇航员, my dream is to be an astronaut — picture ③; (3) 为了实现梦想，我要努力学习, I will study hard to make my dream come true — picture ④, the girl reading; (4) 坐车要系好安全带, buckle up in the car — picture ①, the boy in his seat belt.

exercises.title: 读一读，连一连

note.zh: 左边是问题，右边是回答。先点问题，再点它的回答。另外：练习册第80页练习3的对话里印着"2014年中国正式开展了嫦娥探月工程"，这是印错了：课本第125页写的是二〇〇四年，练习册第73页和第76页也都是2004年。2004年才对。
note.en: Questions on the left, answers on the right. Tap a question, then its answer. Also: The dialogue in exercise 3 on workbook p. 80 prints 2014 as the year China began the Chang'e moon program. That is a misprint: the textbook (p. 125, 二〇〇四年) and workbook pp. 73 and 76 all say 2004, which is right.

left: 这些字我怎么看不明白？
right: 月球是一个荒凉的世界。
这些字里有一些是错别字。

explanation.zh: 问月球是什么样的，答：月球是一个荒凉的世界。
explanation.en: Asked what the moon is like, the answer is 月球是一个荒凉的世界 — a desolate world.

explanation.zh: "怎么去"问的是坐什么去：我坐飞机去北京。
explanation.en: 怎么去 asks how you travel, so the answer names the way: 我坐飞机去北京, by plane.

items.left: 这些字我怎么看不明白？

explanation.zh: 看不明白的原因：这些字里有一些是错别字。
explanation.en: Why the characters make no sense: 这些字里有一些是错别字 — some of them are written wrongly.

explanation.zh: 问梦想，答：我的梦想是登上月球。
explanation.en: Asked about a dream, the answer is 我的梦想是登上月球, to land on the moon.

exercises.title: 你知道太空中有什么吗？请写一写（五十字以上）
exercises.title_en: Do you know what's in space? Please write with more than 50 characters

note.zh: 提示：（1）太空中有哪些星球？（2）地球周围有什么星球？（3）你是怎么知道的？知道后你的感受是什么？
note.en: Prompts: (1) What heavenly bodies are there in space? (2) What heavenly bodies are around the Earth? (3) How do you know? How do you feel about it now that you know?

items.prompt: 写一写太空中有什么（五十字以上）。
items.prompt_en: Write about what is in space (more than 50 characters).
